article.headline: Chammaa's 27 help San Jose State defeat UTSA 95-74
article.description: — Joey Chammaa's 27 points helped San Jose State defeat UTSA 95-74 on Monday in a season opener for both teams.
article.linkText: Chammaa's 27 help San Jose State defeat UTSA 95-74

categories.description: UTSA Roadrunners @ San José State Spartans

event.description: UTSA Roadrunners @ San José State Spartans

keywords: UTSA Roadrunners @ San José State Spartans
article.story: SAN JOSE, Calif. -- — Joey Chammaa's 27 points helped San Jose State defeat UTSA 95-74 on Monday in a season opener for both teams. Chammaa added six assists for the Spartans. Mekhi Mason added 26 points while going 8 of 16 from the floor, including 5 for 11 from 3-point range, and 5 for 6 from the line. Robert Vaihola had 13 points and finished 6 of 6 from the floor. Preston Turner and Shey Eberwein each scored 15 points for UTSA. Isaiah Coleman finished with 12 points. San Jose State took the lead with 10:53 left in the first half and did not trail again. Mason led his team in scoring with 17 points in the first half to help put them up 45-27 at the break. San Jose State pulled away with a 10-0 run in the second half for a 27-point lead. They outscored UTSA by three points in the final half, as Chammaa led the way with a team-high 13 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
